name: Search the catalogue and open a sample product
description: Verifies visitors can find a product by name, open its detail page, and reach a WhatsApp enquiry that names the product.
steps: Open the Products page from the main navigation
Open View Details on the Toner Cartridge card
expected: Only the Toner Cartridge card is listed and it is labelled as a sample listing. Its detail page shows the product name, the text Contact for price, a note asking the visitor to confirm compatibility, and an Enquire on WhatsApp button whose link starts with https://wa.me/2348185438551 and includes Toner Cartridge in the message.

name: Filter by category, see empty results, and clear filters
description: Verifies catalogue filters narrow the list, show a clear empty state, and can be reset.
expected: Selecting Consumables shows only Printer Consumable with an updated product count. Searching zzzzqq shows a no products match message with a count of zero. Clear filters restores the full list of sample products.

name: Mobile menu and contact form validation
description: Verifies the mobile menu routes to Contact and the contact form rejects empty and invalid input without submitting.
steps: Open the menu using the menu button
Press Send enquiry with every field empty
Enter 'QA Visitor' as name, '08000000000' as phone, 'not-an-email' as email, and 'Test' as message, then press Send enquiry
expected: The menu opens and leads to the Contact page, which shows both telephone numbers as links. The empty submit shows required-field errors for name, phone and message. The invalid email shows an email error and no success message appears.

name: Works and Clients pages show slideshows or an honest empty state
covers: database read of published showcase items
description: Verifies the Our Work and Clients pages load and never show invented content.
steps: Open the Our Work page from the main navigation
Open the Clients page from the main navigation
Open the Home page and scroll to the Our Work and Our Clients sections
expected: Each page loads with its heading. Each shows either published slides with previous and next controls, or a message saying nothing has been published yet. The Home page contains both sections.

name: Admin area is closed to visitors
description: Verifies an anonymous visitor only sees a sign-in form and no catalogue management controls.
steps: Click Staff login in the footer
expected: An Admin sign in form with email and password fields is shown. No product, work, client or enquiry management controls are visible and there is no option to create an account.
